p1_t3_defect_site.finding: The WO's stated Phase 2 goal — rank candidates by locality same_file(0) > imported(1) > global(2) — is ALREADY the shipped behavior, and has been since the Phase 4 symbol-table collapse. The docblock at 1154-1168 states the priority explicitly and the implementation follows it: lines 1199-1223 take same-file entries first (with an additional qualifierPath/scopePath refinement that the WO does not propose), lines 1225-1234 take imported-scope entries bound to the calling file, lines 1236-1243 fall back to project-wide.
p1_t3_defect_site.residual_ambiguity_shape: What remains is WITHIN-tier ambiguity, which proximity ranking cannot break by construction: 2+ same-file candidates that scope-matching cannot separate (line 1219), 2+ imported candidates (1233), 2+ project-wide (1242).
p1_t3_defect_site.note_on_import_resolutions: classifyBareCall accepts importResolutions and deliberately discards it (void importResolutions, line 1179) because the symbol table already carries imported-scope rows produced by Phase 3 (the AC-07 seam at lines 599-608). Any redesign that reaches for the import-resolver output directly would be re-deriving data the table already holds.

p1_t4_shadowing_sample.method: Detailed page of ambiguous edges filtered to file=src/, n=12, taken 12:50Z.
p1_t4_shadowing_sample.finding: 10 of 12 sampled src ambiguous edges are ambiguous ONLY because a stale compiled tree is in the scan universe. Each candidate set is the real symbol paired with its dist-preXR/ compiled twin: this.cache.has() -> {src/scanner/lru-cache.ts#LRUCache.has, dist-preXR/src/scanner/lru-cache.js#LRUCache.has}; scanner.scanFile() -> {src/analyzer/ast-element-scanner.ts#ASTElementScanner.scanFile, dist-preXR/.../ast-element-scanner.js#...}. Both would resolve cleanly with the twin removed. Where a name is genuinely polysemous the twin doubles it: this.cache.clear() returns 20 candidates = 10 real classes x 2 trees.
p1_t4_shadowing_sample.second_finding: 10 of 12 carry reason field_based_acg and a non-empty receiver, meaning they are classified by the MEMBER-ACCESS branch (branch 2, line 680), not by classifyBareCall at all. classifyBareCall is the no-receiver path. Only the 2 visit edges (receiver empty) reach it. The WO therefore proposes to change a function that does not produce the bulk of the population it targets.
p1_t4_shadowing_sample.genuine_residue: The 2 real cases are same-file duplicates: two distinct local functions both named visit in src/analyzer/ast-element-scanner.ts at :162 and :469. Tier-1 ambiguity that the existing qualifierPath refinement did not separate. This is a real, small, and different problem from the one the WO describes.
p1_t4_shadowing_sample.risk_001_disposition: RISK-001 (over-eager same-file resolution on shadowed names) cannot be measured as stated, because same-file elevation is already in production and has been for several phases. The risk it names is already carried by shipped code, not introduced by this WO.

scan_scope_defect.statement: The scan universe contains a stale compiled build tree that .coderefignore does not exclude. .coderefignore lists dist/ and build/ but the repo currently also holds dist-preXR/ (520 .js/.d.ts files, untracked by git). It was named dist-old/ earlier in this same session and was renamed under us mid-measurement.
measured_impact: 3,049 of 4,753 unresolved edges (64%) originate in dist-preXR/ — almost all unresolved IMPORT edges from .d.ts files.
Every class method in the tree is duplicated as a candidate, manufacturing ambiguity across the member-access population (10/12 sampled).

Both pollutants land INSIDE unresolved_src_count and ambiguous_src_count, because those facets exclude test files, not build output. The stratified honest metric REC-R2 shipped in GX-003 is therefore itself polluted now.
resolved_of_resolvable reads 54.52% against 74.8% at the edge-resolution program's close.
scan_scope_defect.shape: This is the same class as the test-DSL denominator artifact the 731 program just spent four phases resolving, one layer down: a mechanically-detectable population that no resolver can or should resolve, inflating the denominator and depressing every headline.
scan_scope_defect.candidate_fix: Add the compiled trees to .coderefignore and re-populate. Note the load-bearing rule in that file: patterns must be PATH-QUALIFIED or a verified-unique root filename, because shouldIgnorePath matches bare basenames at any depth.
scan_scope_defect.routing: Not filed. Surfaced to the operator with the Phase 1 halt — it may belong to either WO, to the .coderefignore owner, or to its own ticket. Filing it unilaterally would presume the routing.

decision_records.decision: Escalate SCOPE-001 rather than fold it in silently.
